# E3S Web of Conferences

> > An open access platform for publishing peer-reviewed conference proceedings in environment, energy, and earth sciences, indexed in Scopus and DOAJ.

E3S Web of Conferences is a comprehensive open access journal platform operated by EDP Sciences that publishes proceedings from international academic conferences across environmental, energy, and earth science domains. The platform provides researchers with freely accessible, peer-reviewed publications while maintaining rigorous ethical standards and indexing in major academic databases.

## Key Topics

- open access publishing
- conference proceedings
- peer review
- Scopus indexing
- DOAJ Seal
- earth sciences
- environment
- energy
- DOI
- Creative Commons licensing

- academic conferences
- publishing ethics
- COPE compliance
- plagiarism prevention

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://www.e3s-conferences.org): Main portal featuring open access proceedings in environment, energy, and earth sciences with most-read articles
- [About E3S](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/about-the-journal/aims-and-scope): Journal scope covering environmental, energy, and earth science conferences with open access and DOI policy
- [For Authors](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/for-authors): Comprehensive author guidelines including submission instructions, templates, and copyright licensing information

## Conference Collections & Archives

- [Conference Series Directory](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/series): Directory of conference series including AG, ARFEE, ASEE, ASTECHNOVA and other international events
- [Proceedings Archive](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/component/issues): Complete archive of published conference volumes and proceedings from international conferences
- [Advanced Search](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/component/solr): Solr-based advanced search interface with filtering and multi-domain searching capabilities

## Publishing Standards & Quality

- [Publishing Policies & Ethics](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/about-the-journal/publishing-policies-ethics): Publishing ethics standards, COPE compliance, and plagiarism prevention with iThenticate technology
- [Journal Indexing](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/about-the-journal/indexed-in): Indexing information in ProQuest, Cabells, Chemical Abstracts Service, Scopus, and DOAJ databases
- [Editorial Board](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/about-the-journal/editorial-board): Editorial board members overseeing peer review and publication quality

## For Conference Organizers

- [Conference Organizer Guide](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/for-conference-organizers): Comprehensive guide for conference organizers covering publication procedures and partnership agreements

## Account & Access Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/component/services): User services including EDPS Account management, Pay per View access, and email alerts
- [Publisher Information](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/about-the-journal/published-by): Publisher details: EDP Sciences and Web of Conferences platform

## News & Updates

- [Latest News](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/news): News and updates on Scopus indexing, DOAJ Seal achievement, and new conference proceedings
- [Scopus Indexation Update](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/news/388-e3s-web-of-conferences-scopus-indexation-update-and-confirmation): Announcement of Scopus indexation confirmation and DOAJ Seal achievement
- [CIGB 2022 Symposium Proceedings](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/news/376-cigb-2022-icold-cfbr-symposium-sharing-water-multi-purpose-of-reservoirs-and-innovations-proceedings-from-e3s-web-of-conferences): News on dam engineering and water management symposium proceedings publication
- [AGAP Geophysics Conference Collection](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/news/373-collection-d-actes-de-conferences-de-l-agap-new-from-web-of-conferences): Announcement of new geophysics conference collection and proceedings launch

## Optional

- [Recommend Journal](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/component/recommend): Journal recommendation and referral form for sharing with colleagues
